title: Coherent resolved successive geometric Kummer descent
statement: Fix a bundled condensed ring $R$, commutative profinite groups $G_o,G_i$, and the normalized product-bar environment and actual geometric double nerve $N$ over $W$ of [def-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-coordinates]. For a square $V\to T\to U$, $V\to W\to U$, boundary $S\to T$ over $S\to U$, puncture module $L$ on $W$, equivariant condensed module $M$, and their puncture identification, fix nonnegative injective resolutions $I,J,K$ of $L,M,M.module$, with $K$ identified with the underlying complex of $J$. A resolved successive descent is the following data. Apply actual restriction of sections and direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] to every object and operator of $N$ and to $I$; retain a coherent bisimplicial roof of column quasi-isomorphisms to this diagram and to the point pullback of the product bar on $J$. Every column square is the actual root-coordinate restriction and full-root counit mate of [def-sfb-kummer-parameterized-term], followed by internal-Hom evaluation [def-sfb-kummer-bar-resolution], as in the full normalized chart of [def-sfb-kummer-normalized-chart]. Bar term identifications are fixed on all profinite sections, and the canonical finite-total point-pullback identifications are fixed on every summand. The diagonal and inner-first iterated derived-total identifications are normalized by that roof. Their degree-zero column map is fixed componentwise by the actual restriction-of-sections unit, and their augmentations are that unit into degree $(0,0)$ on each resolution degree, and become isomorphisms after localization. The diagonal-to-iterated comparison obtained from these geometric augmentations is the point pullback of the specified augmented product-bar comparison. An isomorphism $\gamma$ has source the pulled-back diagonal total and target successive derived invariants of $M[0]$; it equals that geometric augmentation comparison followed by the normalized iterated-invariant identification. Its composite with the full-bar identification is the point pullback of the specified composite-adjunction comparison $\theta$. The successive augmentation arrow has source the actual derived open image [def-sfb-kummer-local-source] and is defined by the resolution comparison, iterated geometric augmentation and normalized iterated-invariant identification. Refinement means that for every boundary restriction there is the same resolved geometric model whose augmentation arrow equals canonical derived pullback with the composition and point-pullback identifications [def-sfb-kummer-refinement], including identities and composites. This is a specification, not an existence assertion.
